title: Vanilla SkyBlock
description: A server-side only SkyBlock experience for NeoForge 1.21.1. Includes custom void generation, GUI shop, player market, upgrades, and 100+ advancements.
body:
# 🌌 SkyBlock Horizon (Server-Side Core)

A complete, premium, and feature-rich **SkyBlock system** designed specifically for **NeoForge 1.21.1**. 

Unlike other mods, **SkyBlock Horizon runs 100% on the server side**. Players can connect to your server using a completely vanilla Minecraft client—no downloads or installs needed on their end!

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 🌌 Complete Void Generation (With Stronghold Support)
* Generates a completely empty void world (no land, no water, no grass, no ruined portals, no dungeons).
* **Strongholds are preserved!** Players can still find and use the End Portal to defeat the Ender Dragon and access the End.
* Includes a balanced **Starter Chest** containing only: 1x Oak Sapling, 1x Wheat Seeds, 5x Bread, 1x Water Bucket, and 1x Lava Bucket.

### 🏪 Double-Chest GUI Shop (`/shop`)
* A full, beautiful server-side Chest GUI. No ugly text links!
* Offers customized trade menus for buying and selling items in amounts of **1x, 64x, or Sell All**.
* Features categories like Blocks, Farming, Ores, Food, Mob Drops, and Decorations.

### 🧬 Diverse Mob Spawner Tiers (T1–T3)
* Buy custom spawners for **18 different mobs** divided into three tier categories: Common, Advanced, and Elite.
* **Tier 1**: Standard spawners with default spawn rates.
* **Tier 2**: Faster delay, increased spawn count.
* **Tier 3**: Ultra-fast delay, maximum spawn counts for ultimate grinding.
* Properties are safely injected server-side via custom NBT data.

### 🛒 Player-to-Player Market (`/market`)
* A 6-row pagination GUI allowing players to trade with each other.
* List items using `/market sell <price>`.
* Browse, buy, or cancel listings interactively.

### 📈 Balanced Base & Ore Upgrades (`/skyblock upgrade`)
* Expand your island's boundary limit or upgrade the ore generator block chances.
* Upgrades require logical progression items (e.g., wood stacks, stones, blocks) instead of unrealistic iron rates.

### 🏆 100+ Custom SkyBlock Advancements
* Fully custom, progression-oriented advancement tree (106 advancements) tailored for SkyBlock.
* Features milestones for block breaks, mob kills, trading milestones, wealth accumulations, and base levels.
* Syncs automatically with vanilla clients.

### 🛡️ Other Features
* **Live Scoreboard**: Keep track of your coin balance right on the sidebar.
* **Day Transitions**: Server-wide alerts when a new day begins (e.g. `✦ Day 5 has begun! ✦`).
* **Visual Boundaries**: Server-side particles highlight your island border when you get close to its edge.
